dashboard.label: Splunk Engineering Command Center
dashboard.description: Live platform state, normalized Windows telemetry, detection assurance, and RBA outcomes.

div.p: Administration, data quality, detection content and risk-based outcomes on one operator surface.

search.query: | rest /services/server/info | head 1 | eval state="RESPONDING" | fields state
(index=sysmon OR index=windows) earliest=0 | stats count as searchable_events
| rest /servicesNS/-/splunk-detection-lab/saved/searches count=0 | search title="detect_*" | stats count as definitions
index=risk source="splunk-detection-lab:rba" | stats count as modifiers
index=notable source="splunk-detection-lab:rba" | sort 0 - _time | dedup risk_object rule_title | stats count as findings

| rest /servicesNS/-/splunk-detection-lab/saved/searches count=0 | search title="detect_*" disabled=0 | eval cadence=case( cron_schedule="*/5 * * * *","5 minutes", cron_schedule="*/10 * * * *","10 minutes", cron_schedule="*/15 * * * *","15 minutes", true(),cron_schedule ) | stats count as definitions by cadence | eval order=case(cadence="5 minutes",1,cadence="10 minutes",2,cadence="15 minutes",3,true(),99) | sort order | fields cadence definitions

table.title: Index capacity and retention / effective REST state

search.query: | rest /services/data/indexes count=0 | search title=sysmon OR title=windows OR title=risk OR title=notable | eval retention_days=round(frozenTimePeriodInSecs/86400,0) | eval purpose=case( title="sysmon","Sysmon telemetry", title="windows","Native Windows channels", title="risk","RBA modifier store", title="notable","Finding version store", true(),"Other" ) | eval state=case( totalEventCount>=0,"SEARCHABLE", true(),"UNKNOWN" ) | rename title as index totalEventCount as lifetime_events maxTotalDataSizeMB as max_mb | table index purpose lifetime_events max_mb retention_days state | sort index
(index=sysmon OR index=windows OR index=risk OR index=notable) earliest=0 | stats count as events by index sourcetype | eval source=index." / ".sourcetype | fields source events | sort 0 - events

index=sysmon earliest=0 | stats count as events by EventID | eval event_name=case(EventID=1,"Process creation",EventID=10,"Process access",EventID=13,"Registry value",1=1,"Other") | eval event_type="EID ".EventID." / ".event_name | fields event_type events | sort 0 - events

table.title: splunkd service identity / local REST response

search.query: | rest /services/server/info | head 1 | eval service="splunkd" | eval response="RESPONDING" | eval role=mvjoin(server_roles,", ") | rename version as splunk_version build as splunk_build os_name as operating_system | table service response splunk_version splunk_build operating_system role

| makeresults | eval control="Configuration syntax", mechanism="btool check", state="PRE-DEPLOY VERIFIED", evidence="scripts/validate_conf.py + Splunk btool" | fields control mechanism state evidence | append [ | inputlookup allowlist_lsass_access | stats count as entries dc(source_process_name) as normalized_names | eval control="LSASS exact-name allowlist" | eval mechanism="transforms.conf lookup" | eval state=if(entries>0,"RESOLVED / ".entries." ROWS","EMPTY") | eval evidence="allowlist_lsass_access.csv / source_process_name" | fields control mechanism state evidence ] | append [ | makeresults | eval control="Management API" | eval mechanism="splunkd 8089" | eval state="CONFIGURED / LOOPBACK ONLY" | eval evidence="server.conf [httpServer] acceptFrom" | fields control mechanism state evidence ] | table control mechanism state evidence

| rest /servicesNS/-/splunk-detection-lab/saved/searches count=0 | search title="detect_*" | eval state=if(disabled=0,"CONFIGURED","DISABLED") | eval window='dispatch.earliest_time'." to ".'dispatch.latest_time' | eval summary_target=if('action.summary_index'=1,'action.summary_index._name'." / configured","none") | rename title as detection cron_schedule as schedule | table detection schedule window summary_target state | sort 0 detection

| inputlookup detection_catalog | eval saved_search="detect_".replace(detection_id,"\.","_") | lookup detection_validation saved_search OUTPUT result_count event_count scan_count runtime_seconds validation_state validated_at | eval state=case(validation_state="PASS_POSITIVE","SCENARIO POSITIVE",validation_state="PASS_ZERO","DISPATCH PASS / OUT OF SCENARIO",1=1,"NOT VALIDATED") | table state detection_id mitre_techniques result_count event_count scan_count runtime_seconds validated_at | sort 0 state - result_count detection_id
